'''Namana twist''' was a form of [[Namana candy|candy]]. [[Wilek Nereus]] enjoyed them.

==Behind the scenes==
The candy appears in [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']] under an alternate spelling, "Nanana Twist." This could be a typing error as the M key is beside the N key on a computer keyboard. The candy was made with inert gas and berry fruit.<ref name="swg">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Nanana Twist}}</ref>
